summary: Bearer is unaffected by projectiles other than Magic Balls, including their Engulfing effects such as Pinning Arrow; equipment can still be affected.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Only Engulfing effects from projectiles other than Magic Balls (for example Pinning Arrow).

references.name: Pinning Arrow
references.note: Named as an example of an Engulfing projectile effect that does not affect the bearer.

clarifications.text: The bearer's equipment can still be affected by projectiles and their Engulfing effects.

open_questions: N1 'Equipment can still be affected by the above' is read as the bearer's own equipment (e.g. a shield hit by a Specialty Arrow); the text does not say whose equipment.
